answer: Require each new agent to burn a fixed stake before it can transact. One identity costs one burn, so a sybil flood costs that burn times every fake persona: the attacker drowns in an outgoing tide of forfeited value while honest agents pay once. Picture each bond as a timber beam framing an agents standing; cut corners and it rots to umber dust. Faking a thousand identities means burning a thousand bonds, so attack cost scales linearly with the number of sockpuppets, which quickly outruns any gain.
